card.title: Ready to race?
card.subtitle: Sort these out before race day. It takes a minute.
card.allSet: You're all set for race day

items.locationWhy: So family and friends can follow you live
items.background: Location while the phone is locked
items.preciseWhy: Approximate location puts your dot up to a few kilometres off. Switch "Precise location" on for Livio.
items.batteryWhy: So your phone doesn't stop the tracking
items.powerSavingWhy: Turn it off before you start

raceReady.introBody: A minute now means nothing to fix at the start line of {{race}}.
raceReady.introBodyNoRace: A minute now means nothing to fix at the start line.

notifications.title: Get your race reminders
notifications.body: We'll remind you before the race and tell you when it's time to start tracking.

location.title: Let your family and friends follow you live
location.body: Livio uses your location only while you track a race, to show you on the live map.

background.title: Keep tracking with your phone in your pocket
background.body: Choose "Always" (iPhone) or "Allow all the time" (Android). Without it, tracking stops when the screen locks.

locationServices.title: Switch on your phone's location
locationServices.body: Your phone's location is off, so nothing can be tracked. Turn it on in settings.

precise.title: Turn on precise location
precise.body: Livio has only your approximate location, so your family would see you kilometres away from the course. In Livio's location settings, switch "Precise location" on.

battery.title: Don't let your phone stop the tracking
battery.body: Allow Livio to run without battery optimisation, so a long race isn't cut short.

raceReady.doneBody: On race day, open Livio and press Start. Your family can follow you live.
raceReady.doneLater: You can finish this any time from the home screen.

notifications.statusNotAsked: Notifications are not set up yet
notifications.bodyOn: You'll get race reminders and checkpoint alerts for the athletes you follow.
notifications.bodyOff: You won't get race reminders or checkpoint alerts. Your phone only lets an app ask once, so switch them on in your phone's settings.
notifications.bodyNotAsked: Get race reminders and checkpoint alerts for the athletes you follow.

followPrompt.title: Know when they pass each checkpoint?
followPrompt.body: We'll send you an alert at every checkpoint and at the finish.

idle.noRaceBody: Connect your next race to track it live and let your family follow you.
